payload.title: Signal Mining Slice 01 — research and planning only
payload.intent: Mine ten years of LLM chats, documents, repo activity and system data for context, memory, intent, data and signalling patterns. Do not build new infra yet. Finish the thinking into an executable plan and prove the first slice.

chat_reference.note: User requested details and chat link. Runtime cannot access the browser conversation URL; preserve this idempotency key and commit as the trace handle. Add actual ChatGPT URL if available from operator browser history.

operator_direction: Do not build again before research and planning are mature.
Context, memory, intent, data and other signals are all part of signalling.
We have around ten years of normal-person signal across LLM chats, documents and data.
Put the data under graph tests and simulations to discover what is already there.
Mining comes first: skip planting/growing and harvest existing signal.

deliverables.name: signals/schema/signal_event_v0.json
constraints: must support timestamp, source, thread_id, intent, actions, outcome, entities, tags, confidence, evidence_ref

sources: other LLM profiles and activity captures already gathered
selected Google Drive docs only after source map is stable
first_slice.volume_cap: 5k-10k normalised events max for first proof

graph_tests: Repeat Intent Test: same intent >3 times means stuck loop or strategic anchor
Fail Cluster Test: repeated failures around same entity means broken system surface
Partial Loop Test: intent/action without outcome means unfinished leverage
Asset Emergence Test: reused entities/templates/docs mean latent IP
Execution Gap Test: intents with no action means thinking-to-doing leakage
Context Drift Test: source instructions diverging over time
Actor Confusion Test: LLM repeatedly asking where things live
HITL Friction Test: work blocked by human handoff that should be automated
simulations: Completion sim: what if partial loops were finished
No-HITL sim: what could run without operator intervention
Asset reuse sim: what if every reusable asset was applied once
Focus sim: what if only top 10 percent signal was used
Kill sim: what low-value loops should be stopped
hard_constraints: Research and plan only until accepted
acceptance_criteria: A committed plan exists in repo with exact source map and first-slice boundaries
At least one receipt is written under receipts/runtime or equivalent proof path
Plan names the first five extraction queries and validation traces
Plan identifies what not to build yet
Plan includes rollback and stand-down criteria
Operator can hand this to PEN/Symbio without another explanation

meta.proof_expected: receipt in receipts/runtime matching idempotency_key or GitHub commit receipt
